verdict.rationale: Wave's own docs say you can add your bookkeeper or accountant as users and grant them admin, editor, or viewer roles on Pro. That covers role-scoped access for an external accountant. However, the docs don't spell out the invitation flow or exactly which book-adjustment rights (journal entries, categorization edits) each role carries, and the full role set is gated behind the paid Pro plan. missing for 10: documented invite workflow, per-role permission detail for reviewing vs. adjusting ledger entries, independent/hands-on corroboration, availability of editor/viewer roles on the free plan

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Grant trusted individuals—like partners, collaborators, or accountants—access to your Wave account as a payroll manager or Block Advisors tax pro (free), or admin, editor, or viewer (Pro).
Add multiple users, such as your bookkeeper or accountant
